data.name: Maysoon
data.gender_notes: Maysoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘maysunah’ meaning ‘moon’ or ‘moonlit night’. The name Maysoon carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Maysoon usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beauty and grace of the night sky, as well as the nurturing and protective qualities of a mother
data.etymology: Maysoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maysoon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: ميسون
in_arabic.long_meaning: ميسون هي اسم علم مؤنث عربي الأصل، ومعناه الفتاة الجميلة والخجولة، ويتكون من ثلاثة أحرف، وميسون هي كلمة مشتقة من اسم ميسون بنت بحدل، وكانت امرأة جميلة خجولة، وذكر اسم ميسون في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة

in_urdu.name: ميسون
in_urdu.long_meaning: ميسون ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب خوبصورت اور شرمیلی لڑکی ہے، اس نام کا ذکر قرآن پاک میں بھی ہے، اور یہ نام عرب کے مشہور قبائل میں سے ایک قبیلہ کے نام سے ماخوذ ہے

in_hindi.name: मैसून
in_hindi.long_meaning: मैसून एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ सुंदर और शर्मीली लड़की है, इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरान में भी है, और यह नाम अरब के प्रसिद्ध कबीलों में से एक कबीले के नाम से लिया गया है

in_pashto.name: مېسون
in_pashto.long_meaning: مېسون د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې ښکلې او شرمېنځه نارینه ده، دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، او دا نوم د عرب د نامتو قومونو څخه یو قوم د نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی

in_english.name: Maysoon
in_english.long_meaning: Maysoon is an Arabic name that means beautiful and shy girl, derived from the Arabic root, and mentioned in the Quran, it is a name associated with beauty, modesty and virtue in Islamic tradition

pronunciation.urdu: ميسون کی تلفظ میں ميم، ي و ن کی آواز ہوتی ہے
pronunciation.hindi: मैसून का उच्चारण म्य-सून होता है
pronunciation.pashto: مېسون د تلفظ په توګه می-سون وایي

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Maysoon' is of Arabic origin and its meaning is associated with the magnificent beauty and tranquility of a moonlit night. It evokes a sense of serenity, peace, and romance, characteristic of Middle Eastern cultures. This name is popular among Arabic speaking communities and is often given to baby girls to reflect optimism, hope, and a beautiful future.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the moon holds significant spiritual importance. It is a symbol of regular cycles and constant change. The phases of the moon reflect the ebb and flow of life, and its light represents guidance and divine illumination. The name 'Maysoon' reminds us of the transcendent power and everlasting presence of Allah in our lives, inspiring us to seek His energy and light at all times.
